title: Verified recovery checks
intro: Extra practice a course can generate when a learner needs another try. The server's operator installs the trusted generators; you approve which ones this version may use, the question banks they draw on and what each costs. Approving never marks anything as mastered and never raises the course's allowance.
notAllowed: A connected owner or administrator can configure qualified recovery.
noCreators: No practice generators are installed. The server's operator must install them first.

configurationHint: Question banks listed here stay on the server: learners never receive them. Changing costs or generators needs a new approval.
